name: verified_rust
description: Native transactional Rust source edits and verified build/test capabilities (opt in).

tools.name: build_workspace
tools.description: Build the Rust workspace and independently verify success. Use scope=workspace. Only a committed runtime receipt proves the configured build succeeded.

tools.name: run_workspace_tests
tools.description: Run and independently verify tests for the Rust workspace. Use scope=workspace. Only a committed runtime receipt proves the declared test check passed.

tools.name: modify_source
tools.description: Replace an existing workspace source file transactionally. First inspect_file for expected_sha256. Praxis snapshots the file, checks its formatting and workspace compilation, and rolls back a failed edit. Only a committed runtime receipt counts as implementation applied.
